abstract: FactSet analyzed S&P 500 earnings conference call transcripts from Q1 2025 (March 15 - June 4, 2025) to measure the prevalence of AI discussion among major corporations. 210 S&P 500 companies cited the term "AI" during their Q1 earnings calls, marking the fifth consecutive quarter where more than 200 companies discussed AI, though this represented a 14% quarter-over-quarter decline from Q4 2024's record of 243 companies. The Information Technology sector led with 94% of companies mentioning AI.
keyFindings: 210 S&P 500 companies cited "AI" on Q1 2025 earnings calls, well above the 5-year average of 114 and 10-year average of 72 companies.
Q1 2025 marked the fifth consecutive quarter in which more than 200 S&P 500 companies cited AI on earnings calls.
The number of companies citing AI declined 14% quarter-over-quarter from Q4 2024 (243 companies) to Q1 2025 (210 companies).
Information Technology sector had the highest AI mentions with 61 companies (94% of the sector) citing AI on Q1 earnings calls.
Eight of eleven sectors recorded quarter-over-quarter decreases in AI mentions, with Industrials (-7) and Consumer Staples (-6) leading the declines.
methodology: FactSet Document Search was used to search for the term "AI" in earnings conference call transcripts of all S&P 500 companies that conducted earnings calls from March 15 through June 4, 2025. Data was analyzed by sector and compared to historical averages (5-year and 10-year) and prior quarter results.
qualifiers: The analysis searches for the specific term "AI" only and may not capture all artificial intelligence-related discussions using alternative terminology. Some charts and commentary normally published in the FactSet Earnings Insight report were not available in the published version.
